Errors.blocked_url: This link points to a private or local network address, or isn't http(s), so it can't be downloaded.
Errors.not_found: The server says this file doesn't exist.
Errors.upstream: The other server returned an error. Try again later.
Errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.invalid_state: That action isn't possible right now.
Errors.checksum: The file was damaged in transfer (checksum mismatch). Try again.
Errors.incomplete: The download stopped before the end. Try again to resume.
Errors.unsafe_path: The file name wasn't safe to save.
Errors.drm: This is DRM-protected (paid streaming). AnyGet never downloads DRM content.
Errors.members_only: Only channel members can watch this. AnyGet does not get around that.
Errors.paid: This video must be bought or rented first. AnyGet does not get around that.
Errors.age_restricted: This video needs an age check. Connect your own signed-in account (cookies.txt) and retry.
Errors.login_required: The site wants you to sign in. Connect your own account (cookies.txt) and retry.
Errors.bot_check: The site asked to confirm you're not a bot. Connect your own account (cookies.txt) and retry, or try again later.
Errors.geo_blocked: Not available in your region. AnyGet does not get around region blocks.
Errors.live_not_finished: This is a live or upcoming stream. Try again after it ends.
Errors.unavailable: This video is unavailable or was removed.
Errors.invalid_cookies: That isn't a cookies.txt file (Netscape format).
Errors.restricted: archive.org restricts access to this item, so it can't be downloaded.
Errors.borrow_only: This item can only be borrowed from archive.org's lending library. AnyGet does not get around that.
Errors.rate_limited: The site's limit for anonymous requests was reached. Try again later, or add your own API token.
Errors.in_copyright: This is in copyright, so it is not legally downloadable. Borrow or buy it instead.
Errors.needs_key: This source needs a free API key. Add it to your .env file.
Errors.tool_missing: The tool for this conversion is not installed on this computer.
Errors.forbidden: The site refused the download (403). Signing in with your own account usually fixes this; updating yt-dlp can help too.
Errors.not_a_file: The link opened a web page instead of the file, so nothing was saved.

Errors.csrf: That request was refused. Reload the page and try again.

Help.title: Help
Help.intro: AnyGet saves public files from many sites to this computer. Here is how to use it.

paste.title: Paste a link
paste.text: Paste one or many links on Home and press Check link. The preview shows what is behind the link: formats for videos, files for repositories and web pages, pages for library items. Pick what you want and press Download.

sources.title: Sources
sources.text: Pages for YouTube and video sites, archive.org, the Wayback Machine, code hosts, image galleries, books and libraries help you find things. Search everything searches books, libraries, archive.org and videos at once.

library.title: Library
library.text: Every finished download is listed in the Library with a preview. Tag files, find copies of the same file, and remove what you do not need.

watch.title: Watches
watch.text: Add a channel, playlist or archive.org collection on the Watches page. AnyGet checks it on schedule and downloads only new items.

convert.title: Convert
convert.text: Finished files can be converted from Downloads: make a scanned PDF searchable (OCR), merge page images into a PDF, or save audio as MP3.

cli.title: Command line
cli.text: Run anyget get LINK in a terminal to download without the website, anyget search "title" to find books, and anyget watch-clipboard to offer every link you copy.

remote.title: From your phone
remote.text: AnyGet runs on your computer. To use it from anywhere, put it behind Cloudflare Access or Tailscale (see the deploy guide).

submit.text: Check the links in the paste box

Help.legalLink: Read the legal and fair use rules

Legal.title: Legal and fair use
Legal.intro: AnyGet is a personal tool. These rules are built into it and cannot be turned off.

personal.title: Personal use
personal.text: Download only what you own, what is public domain or openly licensed, or what the site allows you to download.

drm.title: No DRM
drm.text: DRM-protected content (paid streaming, music services, paid ebooks) is never downloaded.

shadow.title: No shadow libraries
shadow.text: Pirate book sites such as LibGen, Z-Library or Anna's Archive are never used as sources.

bypass.title: No bypassing
bypass.text: Region blocks, lending and borrow limits, paywalls and members-only content are respected. AnyGet shows a clear message instead.

copyright.title: Books in copyright
copyright.text: Books still in copyright are shown as not legally downloadable, with links to borrow or buy them.

cookies.title: Your own accounts only
cookies.text: A cookies.txt file may only come from accounts you are legally signed in to. It stays on this computer.

etiquette.title: Be a good guest
etiquette.text: AnyGet limits parallel downloads per site, backs off when a site asks it to slow down, and identifies itself honestly.

Legal.disclaimer: You are responsible for what you download. When in doubt, check the site's terms and your local law.

Share.title: Nothing to download
Share.noLink: The shared text has no link in it. Share a web page or a link to a file.
